object.attr: as implemented: agents issue documents too, and get the same PDF as the Export action. The tool's parameters are in MELLON-MCP-SRS-36's table, and the read-only server refuses the tool (MELLON-MCP-SRS-99).
object.description: The MCP server shall have an export tool that, given a document and an output path, exports the document to a PDF file at the output path.
